minor.issue: Crashes with AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'get' at server.py:553 when a client_doc has private_info=None AND client_type=='private' (or company_info=None AND client_type=='company'). Triggered during testing when a minimal POST payload created a client with both info fields NULL; subsequent GET /api/clients returned 500 for the whole collection. Not a regression from reset but a pre-existing latent bug in get_client_display_name/get_client_phone/get_client_email. Cleanup performed via direct Mongo delete.

action_items: (Low priority, out of scope for reset test) Harden server.py:545-569 get_client_display_name/get_client_phone/get_client_email against private_info=None / company_info=None (add `or {}` guards) to prevent 500 on GET /api/clients if a client is ever persisted without the required info block. Alternatively enforce it in ClientCreate validator.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:571-574 restricts POST /api/clients to UserRole.MANAGER only, but ClientCreate accepts private_info/company_info as Optional — combined with get_client_display_name that dereferences .get on the result, this is a latent 500 vector. Should either (a) enforce presence of one of the two info blocks in a Pydantic validator, or (b) defensively coerce None→{} in the getter helpers.

server.py:545-569 (get_client_display_name, get_client_phone, get_client_email): use `private_info = client.get('private_info', {}) or {}` (the `or {}` guard is missing when the DB value is explicitly None, not just missing).
Route /system/users referenced by external docs but the real route is /users; not a bug, just a doc mismatch. The sidebar itself uses the correct /users path.

context_for_next_testing_agent: App is stable on empty DB. Only known latent bug: GET /api/clients returns 500 if a client is stored with both private_info=None and company_info=None (see backend_issues.minor). To reproduce: POST /api/clients with client_type='private' but no private_info body, then GET /api/clients. Not triggered by normal UI flow (modal enforces Nome required). Google Sheets OAuth token preserved in db.google_tokens id='sheets' — do NOT touch. All routes verified in AppLayout.js sidebar match App.js routing.
rca of the issue: get_client_display_name at server.py:545 assumes private_info/company_info dicts always exist when accessed. On empty DB tests, a POST with an incomplete payload stored a client with both fields None; the subsequent GET list-clients crashed on `private_info.get(...)`. Mitigation: add `or {}` guard in the three getter helpers, or make ClientCreate require exactly one of {private_info, company_info}. Immediate fix: DB cleaned via direct Mongo delete_many({}), which restored /api/clients to healthy 200.
